_readme: Copy this file to config/testbed.local.json and fill it in.
config/testbed.local.json is git-ignored. Real hosts, users, URLs, pins and passwords go ONLY there.
Keys that start with '_' are comments. Empty strings mean 'use the default for this OS'.

secrets._fbagent_token: Empty: tb.py generates one token per host and keeps it in state/state.json.
secrets._firebird_initial_password: Password the Firebird installer sets; 05-dbms changes it to firebird_password.

firebird_installer._readme: Used by 'hosts prepare' on Linux hosts without Firebird: an HQbird/Firebird installer script URL.
firebird_installer.linux_url: <https URL of the HQbird Linux installer script>
firebird_installer._linux_urls: Optional: one installer per firebird.engine of a host; linux_url is the fallback.

digitalocean._readme: Optional: 'tb.py do create' makes one droplet per host and writes ssh/addr into this file. destroy deletes only droplets with 'tag'.
digitalocean.token_file: <path to a file with the DigitalOcean API token>
digitalocean.ssh_key_fingerprint: <MD5 fingerprint of an ssh key registered in DigitalOcean>

artifacts._readme: Local copies used by 'install --source local'. Paths are on the operator machine.

goafts._readme: Used by 'install --source goafts'. url = bootstrap URL (port 9443). pin = SPKI SHA-256 of the server certificate, 64 hex characters.
goafts._product_install: direct: download hqclusternode/hqbirdrcm from goafts and register the services. agent: let fbagent install them (fbagent --product-update <id> --apply).

admin._readme: Optional. When set, tb.py approves the CSR of each host (exact host name, the host's address, one request per host) and can deregister agents on uninstall.

loadgen._readme: fb-loadgen source: a git URL, or a local checkout, or a ready binary.

ssh._readme: OpenSSH client on the operator machine. key may be empty when an ssh-agent holds it.

master._ssh: user@host, or 'local' to run on this machine. The user must be root on Linux (or set sudo: true) and an administrator on Windows.
master._addr: Address the other nodes use to reach this host. Goes into certificates and peer URLs.
master._ports: firebird.port / fbagent.port: 0 = from the host (RemoteServicePort in firebird.conf, else 3050; local_api.listen of an existing agent, else 13055).
master._engine: firebird.engine: 2.5, 3.0, 4 or 5; empty = the node finds it. 2.5/3.0: the node uses its default replconf file.

replica1._ports: firebird.port / fbagent.port: 0 = from the host (RemoteServicePort in firebird.conf, else 3050; local_api.listen of an existing agent, else 13055).

lab._readme: tools/lab: private copies of HQbird 2.5/3.0 on this Windows machine, run as applications; the services they are copied from are never touched.
lab.stock_password: <SYSDBA password of a stock Firebird kit as shipped>
